ledger.x: October 1915: the Germans set up the Government General of Warsaw over the north-western half of Congress Poland.
5 November 1916: Germany and Austria-Hungary proclaim the Kingdom of Poland on the occupied land.
6-7 October 1918: the Germans hand over the administration and the Regency Council declares independence.
11 November 1918: the German occupation ends with the armistice and Poland is reborn.
